run_compare_llama_weights: run the script to compare two llama checkpoint directories and print the top 10 largest weight deltas
compare_consolidated_shards: compare consolidated checkpoint shard files between two directories and report tensor-level differences
analyze_weight_deltas: analyze the maximum absolute delta between corresponding tensors in two llama model checkpoints
review_main_function: review the main function that loads and compares paired consolidated checkpoint shards from two directories
test_checkpoint_comparison: test the checkpoint comparison tool by running it against two llama model checkpoint directories
